items.quote: Lawrence and his crew showed up on time and they were very professional. I had my driveway and back pool deck cleaned by them and was very happy and grateful for an excellent job!

These guys do an great job. The before and after was night and day! They'll make a dirty roof, patio or driveway look brand new again. Lawrence handled things with honesty, integrity and genuinely cares for the clients needs and concerns.

Lawrence showed up at my home on time ready to work with his associate. He walked me through the whole process as he was doing the job. Very professional, organized and his price was very reasonable. I'd definitely use his service again.
